resources.string: Design a clock. Wear it on your home screen.
A customizable clock with your colors, fonts, border and photo or video background.
Full-screen clock over a video or photo you picked.
Preview this design at several widget sizes
Design a clock, then put it on your home screen.
Pick a style, choose a photo or video, tune the type.
No designs yet. Create one and it appears here.
Video or photo behind the clock, screen kept awake.
The clock behind your icons, over a photo or a slowly moving video.
To place a widget: long-press an empty home-screen spot → Widgets → ClockCanvas, then drag it out. Resize with the corner handles.
Customising makes a copy owned by this widget, so the other widgets using this design keep looking the way they do now.
A home-screen widget cannot play video. The widget shows a frame from the clip; the full-screen clock and the live wallpaper play it.
The photo or video is no longer readable (it may have been deleted or moved). The clock still shows with the design\u2019s colours.
This widget now has its own design. Changing it here only affects widget #%1$d.
Tap: show or hide controls · Swipe left/right: switch design · Long-press: open the editor

The live wallpaper paints your clock full-bleed behind the home screen, over a photo or a frame-stepped video. Motion is capped here because a wallpaper surface cannot host a video decoder; use the full-screen clock for real playback.
This device does not expose the live-wallpaper picker. Use Settings → Wallpaper instead.

Runs a quiet ongoing notification so widgets update on the minute even when the app is closed. Turn it off to save battery: the clock then follows the system widget budget (every 15 minutes at worst).
If your launcher stops updating widgets in Doze, allowing ClockCanvas to be unoptimised keeps the minute tick reliable.
Everything stays on this device: designs, widget bindings and picked photos are read through the system Photo Picker, never uploaded, and no storage permission is requested.
Inter, Space Grotesk, Bebas Neue, Playfair Display and Source Code Pro - all SIL Open Font License 1.1, license texts shipped in the app.
Applied to every design that shows a date. The clock always honours the pattern you pick here unless the design overrides it.
That clipboard text is not a ClockCanvas export
No app accepted the export; the file is in the app cache at exports/clockcanvas-designs.json
Battery optimisation controls need Android 6 or newer
ClockCanvas is already allowed to run in the background
Open system settings and allow ClockCanvas to ignore battery optimisation
Show just the clock, so your own wallpaper stays visible behind it. Turn this off to let ClockCanvas paint the photo or video.
Half-second repaints instead of once a minute. Noticeably nicer on an analog or seconds design, and it costs battery.

Advances the clip one frame per second behind your icons. A home-screen surface cannot host a video decode surface, so motion here is frame-stepped and capped; the full-screen clock plays the real thing at 30 fps.
Android only lets the system apply a live wallpaper. Tap Apply, then pick ClockCanvas in the wallpaper sheet - the preview above is what you will get.
The selected clip is no longer readable. The wallpaper falls back to the design colours until you pick again.
Saved. Apply it in the wallpaper sheet.
